type.description: type1: trouble inside the provision's own words. type2: trouble in how the provision stands with another part of the instrument. none: not a construction risk — commercial exposure, a missing protection, a drafting preference.

subtype.description: The taxonomy sub-code; none when type is none.

issue.description: For type1 and type2 only, else an empty string. The tool's finding restated as the dataset records defects: one or two sentences, past tense of a dispute. Type 1 quotes the word or phrase and gives the rival readings; type 2 names the other provision and what the pair leaves unsettled. Every term, reading and provision named must come from the tool's own text or the clause's words — nothing added, no advice, no party's interest.

reason.description: One or two sentences: what the tool is worried about, and why that is or is not something a court would construe. For type2, name the other provision.
